tasks.task: I need to produce a quick Stripe pricing brief for the "Redwood Retail Price Intelligence" project (bd_prj_01J3G0X6YQ7VQ8N3H2M1M8Q0A1) using only official stripe.com sources, and I need it today with a verifiable audit trail of the exact tool calls. Use the canonical https://stripe.com/pricing page and return structured JSON covering transaction fees, pricing tiers, and any volume/enterprise notes.

success_criteria: whoami returns project.id = bd_prj_01J3G0X6YQ7VQ8N3H2M1M8Q0A1 and api_key.id = bd_key_01J8Z4K9Q2M7T1V6C3H8N0D5S9 with entitlements.features.extract = true
extract returns a JSON object containing source_url = "https://stripe.com/pricing" and a non-empty pricing_items array
session_stats.result.counts_by_tool_name includes at least one call to "scrape_as_html" and at least one call to "extract" in the current session context

args.extraction_prompt: Extract Stripe pricing information focused on (1) transaction fees, (2) pricing tiers/plans if stated, and (3) any volume/enterprise/discount notes. Return JSON with fields: source_url, pricing_items (array of {product_or_tier, fees, conditions}), enterprise_or_volume_notes, currency_if_stated, last_updated_or_page_date_if_present.

tasks.task: For the active project "Redwood Retail Price Intelligence" (project id bd_prj_01J3G0X6YQ7VQ8N3H2M1M8Q0A1), generate an up-to-date structured summary of the official Stripe pricing page for our internal pricing playbook by EOD today. Use a search step to confirm the canonical Stripe pricing URL, then scrape and extract pricing/fees into JSON, and finally pull session usage stats to confirm the three actions ran successfully.

success_criteria: Step 1 (search_engine) returns status=succeeded for query "site:stripe.com pricing".
Step 2 (scrape_as_html) returns a request record with status=succeeded for url "https://stripe.com/pricing".
Step 3 (extract) returns status=succeeded and a JSON result containing at least page_url and pricing_tiers fields.
Step 4 (session_stats) returns status=succeeded and counts_by_tool_name includes entries for search_engine, scrape_as_html, and extract.

args.extraction_prompt: Extract pricing tiers, transaction fees, and any volume discounts. Return JSON with fields: page_url, pricing_tiers (array of {product_or_tier, fees, pricing_terms}), volume_discounts (array), notes, last_updated_if_present.

tasks.task: For the "Redwood Retail Price Intelligence" project (bd_prj_01J3G0X6YQ7VQ8N3H2M1M8Q0A1), I need an auditable pricing snapshot of Stripe's official pricing page for a compliance packet due today. Use Google SERP to confirm the official URL, then scrape and extract structured fields (tiers, fees, volume discounts, notes, last_updated), and finally provide session usage stats to attach to the packet.

success_criteria: Step 2 (extract) returns request.status == "succeeded" and its output includes the fields tier, fees, volume_discounts, notes, and last_updated.
Step 3 (session_stats) returns status == "succeeded" and counts_by_tool_name shows at least one call each for search_engine, scrape_as_markdown, and extract.

args.extraction_prompt: Extract pricing tiers, transaction fees, and any volume discounts from this page. Return JSON with fields: tier (string), fees (string), volume_discounts (string|null), notes (string|null), last_updated (string; ISO8601 if available, else today's date).
